info.title: recraft/images-vectorize
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "recraft/images-vectorize", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: The JSON body of `POST /proxy/recraft/images/vectorize`, and the Comfy Router input schema for `recraft/images-vectorize`. It names the input image by URL instead of uploading it as a file. The image must be PNG, JPG or WEBP, under 20 MB and at most 16 MP, with each side from 256 to 4096 pixels.

image_url.description: The image to vectorize, as a public http(s) URL or a `data:` URL with base64 image bytes.

response_format.description: How the SVG comes back: `url` (the default) puts a temporary URL in `image.url`, and `b64_json` puts the base64 SVG in `image.b64_json`.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for `recraft/images-vectorize`: Recraft's own vectorize response, forwarded unchanged. The operation is direct-return, so the body is the finished document from the one call, with no task handle and no poll. The SVG is at `image.url`, or inline at `image.b64_json` when the request set `response_format: b64_json`. `credits` is what Recraft charged: 10 for `v1` and 40 for `v1_pro`.

created.description: Unix timestamp when the SVG was created

credits.description: Number of Recraft credits the request used

b64_json.description: Base64-encoded SVG (present instead of `url` when the request set `response_format: b64_json`)

url.description: Temporary URL of the SVG (present when `response_format` is `url`, the default)

RecraftVectorizeVersion.description: The Recraft vectorizer version. `v1` is the standard vectorizer (10 Recraft credits per image). `v1_pro` is Vectorizer Pro (40 Recraft credits per image), which gives cleaner SVGs with smooth curves, straight lines and sharp corners. The request is billed by the credits Recraft reports in the response.
